article.headline: McDaniels' 18 help UTEP defeat Florida A&M 79-46
article.description: — Cam McDaniels had 18 points in UTEP's 79-46 win over Florida A&M on Monday.
article.linkText: McDaniels' 18 help UTEP defeat Florida A&M 79-46
article.story: EL PASO, Texas -- — Cam McDaniels had 18 points in UTEP's 79-46 win over Florida A&M on Monday. McDaniels went 6 of 15 from the field (4 for 9 from 3-point range) for the Miners (3-1). Jace Whiting shot 6 for 11, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc to add 15 points. Reid Cason finished 5 of 9 from the floor to finish with 11 points. Ralph Martino Jr. finished with 15 points for the Rattlers (0-5). Florida A&M also got 10 points from Ben Ndour. UTEP took the lead with 13:33 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. McDaniels led his team in scoring with nine points in the first half to help put them up 41-29 at the break. UTEP pulled away with a 13-1 run in the second half for a 33-point lead. McDaniels led the way with a team-high nine second-half points. Up next UTEP next plays Thursday against New Mexico State on the road. Florida A&M will visit UTSA on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
